info.name: SmartGym - All Endpoints
info.description:
# SmartGym API

Complete API reference grouped by Admin, Staff, Member, and public/integration endpoints. Select the SmartGym environment and set `apiUrl` to the API host.

## Authentication and cookies

`POST /auth/login` returns the user profile in its JSON body and sets two HttpOnly, Secure cookies in the response headers: `access-token` (about 1 hour) and `refresh-token` (about 30 days). Tokens are not returned in JSON. Postman’s cookie jar stores and sends cookies automatically to matching domains and paths. Do not enter token values in an Authorization header, request body, query string, or this collection. The `apiUrl` host must match the cookie domain configured by the API.

Use the login request for the role you want to test before calling protected endpoints. The same cookie names are shared for the API host, so logging in as another role replaces the previous session; log out or use a separate Postman cookie jar/session when switching roles. `POST /auth/refresh` reads `refresh-token` and rotates both auth cookies. `POST /auth/logout` invalidates the access token and clears both cookies. Password reset is a separate flow: OTP verification sets a short-lived `reset-token` cookie, which Postman sends automatically to the reset-password endpoint.

Protected endpoint folders require the matching role cookie (`ADMIN`, `STAFF`, or `MEMBER`). Authentication and Midtrans endpoints are public by route policy; Midtrans notifications must still contain a valid provider signature. The cookie jar may attach matching cookies to public endpoints too.

## Suggested flows

1. Log in with the intended role, then call that role’s protected endpoints.
2. For member check-in, generate a QR token as admin/staff, then use it while logged in as the member. Check-in QR tokens expire; request a fresh token when needed.
3. For membership or trainer purchases, create the order first and use the returned payment URL; payment notifications should be sent by Midtrans with a valid signature.

Request examples use environment variables and placeholders. Replace IDs/OTP values with values from your environment and API responses. Avoid publishing real credentials, session cookies, OTP codes, webhook signatures, or member data.

item.description: Protected dashboard endpoints for administrators. Run **Login Admin** first. Postman stores the HttpOnly `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies and automatically sends them to the configured API domain.
item.name: Admin

request.description:
### Login Admin

Authenticate an administrator.

**Authentication: public. On success, the API returns the profile in JSON and sets `access-token` and `refresh-token` as HttpOnly cookies in `Set-Cookie` headers. Postman’s cookie jar stores them; do not copy token values manually.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

request.description:
### List Staff

Return a paginated staff list; `page` is 1-based, `size` is capped at 50, and `name` is an optional search term.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**
Query: `page` is 1-based; `size` controls the page size (maximum 50).

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Create Staff

Create a staff account. Name, email, Indonesian phone number, and password (minimum 8 characters) are required.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Update Staff

Update the staff account identified by `staffId`; request fields may be provided for the values to update.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Delete Staff

Soft-delete the staff account identified by `staffId`.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

Return the total staff count.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Request Member OTP

Send an OTP to the email address that will be used to create a member account.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

### List Membership Packages

List available membership packages grouped by membership type.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

request.description:
### Generate QR Token

Generate a signed, short-lived QR token for the gym check-in station. A new token can be saved to `checkinQrToken` by this request test.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### List Recent Check-ins

Return the latest check-in records; `limit` is between 1 and 100.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**
Query: `limit` controls the result count (1–100).

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Check-in Summary

Return overall attendance history, today’s check-ins (Jakarta time), and current members on the floor.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

Close the active check-in for the member identified by `{{memberId}}`. No request body is required.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin; Postman sends the HttpOnly cookies automatically. Ensure the API host matches the cookie domain.**

### List All Transactions

Return a paginated transaction list; `page` is 1-based and `size` is capped at 50.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**
Query: `page` is 1-based; `size` controls the page size (maximum 50).

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Transaction Summary

Return yearly income and transaction counts by status. `year` is an optional query parameter; if omitted, the API uses the current server year.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in Admin. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first.**
Query: `year` is optional (example: `2026`).

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope.

request.description:
### Get Active Check-in

Return the authenticated member’s active granted check-in. If none exists, the API returns a successful response with no active data.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in member. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Get My Check-ins

Return only the authenticated member’s check-in history, newest first. `page` is 1-based, `size` is capped at 50, and optional `status` is GRANTED or DENIED.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in member. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**
Query: `page` is 1-based; `size` controls the page size (maximum 50).
Query: `status` is optional; use `GRANTED` or `DENIED` to filter.

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Check In with QR Token

Validate the QR token and create a check-in for the authenticated member. Re-scans while already inside are reported without creating duplicate records; inactive membership produces a denied record.

**Authentication: requires a logged-in member. Postman automatically attaches the `access-token` and `refresh-token` cookies from its cookie jar when the API host/domain matches. Log in using the matching role request first; do not add Bearer tokens or copy cookie values into this request.**
Body: `{ "token": "{{checkinQrToken}}" }`.

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

item.description: Authentication utilities and payment-provider callbacks. Login/refresh/logout and password-reset flows use HttpOnly cookies; Midtrans notifications require a valid provider signature.
item.name: Umum

request.description:
### Request Password Reset OTP

Send a password reset OTP to the supplied email address.

**Authentication: public; this starts the password-reset flow. Reset verification sets a separate short-lived `reset-token` cookie.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Verify Password Reset OTP

Verify the OTP; a successful response sets a short-lived HttpOnly `reset-token` cookie for the next reset request.

**Authentication: public; this starts the password-reset flow. Reset verification sets a separate short-lived `reset-token` cookie.**

Success: 204 No Content; check `Set-Cookie` response headers for cookie updates.

### Reset Password

Set a new password using the `reset-token` cookie from OTP verification. The reset cookie is cleared after success.

**Authentication: uses the short-lived `reset-token` HttpOnly cookie set by OTP verification; Postman sends it automatically for the matching host.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Refresh Token

Use the `refresh-token` cookie to rotate and renew both authentication cookies. No token belongs in the body.

**Authentication: requires the `refresh-token` HttpOnly cookie. Postman sends it automatically and stores the rotated cookies returned by the API.**

Success: 204 No Content; check `Set-Cookie` response headers for cookie updates.

### Logout

Invalidate the current session using `access-token` and clear the access and refresh cookies.

**Authentication: requires the current `access-token` HttpOnly cookie. Postman sends it automatically; success clears both session cookies.**

Success: 204 No Content; check `Set-Cookie` response headers for cookie updates.

### Midtrans Payment Notification (Webhook)

Process a Midtrans webhook. `signature_key`, `status_code`, `order_id`, and `gross_amount` must match a genuine provider notification; do not use a fabricated signature against production.

**Authentication: no SmartGym login cookie required by this route. Midtrans notification is independently authenticated by its provider signature.**

Success: plain `OK` response after provider notification validation.

### Validate Membership Payment

Ask Midtrans for the membership transaction status using `order_id`.

**Authentication: no SmartGym login cookie required by this route. Midtrans notification is independently authenticated by its provider signature.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.

### Validate Trainer Booking Payment

Ask Midtrans for the trainer booking status using `order_id`.

**Authentication: no SmartGym login cookie required by this route. Midtrans notification is independently authenticated by its provider signature.**

Success: standard `ApiResponse` envelope; paginated endpoints also return pagination metadata.
